entry.description: What the path is in the newer manifest (or the older one when removed).

consequence.description: What the user loses when the status is not `ok`.

irreversible_seqs.description: Effects that could not be undone (escaped the Cell or hit the network).

quote.description: Verbatim substring of the referenced assistant turn.

confidence_bp.description: Confidence in basis points (0–10000), integer for deterministic hashing.

evidence_seqs.description: Ledger events that prove the divergence.

claim.description: The claim the divergence is about, when there is one.

confidence_bp.description: Confidence in basis points (0–10000), integer for deterministic hashing.

candidates.description: For ambiguous effects: every call whose window contains it.

Event.description: One entry of the session event stream.

drops_since_last.description: Ring-buffer drops observed by the sensor since the previous event.

process.description: Process that caused the event, when there is one.

seq.description: Dense sequence number within the session, starting at 1.

ts_wall_ms.description: Wall-clock milliseconds since the Unix epoch, for display only.

EventBody.description:
Every event kind of schema v1, adjacently tagged as
`{ "kind": "effect.file.write", "payload": { … } }`.

next_after_seq.description: Pass as `after_seq` for the next page; null on the last page.

FilePath.description: A path as observed in the kernel.

in_cell.description: True when the path is inside the session's Cell (rewindable).

truncated.description: True when path resolution hit its component limit.

FileSide.description: One side of a file diff.

text.description: UTF-8 text; null when absent or binary.

truncated.description: Longer than the limit; `text` holds the beginning.

oneOf.description: The checkpoint's upper layer (the agent changed it).
The real workspace below the Cell (unchanged in the Cell).
The path does not exist at that checkpoint.

bytes.description: Bytes written, aggregated per file descriptor per window.

Graph.description: The causal graph of a session.

agent_root.description: The agent's root process (first exec of the session), if seen.

subject_seq.description: Effect event the decision refers to, when it is effect-time.

dns_name.description: Most recent DNS name that resolved to `addr` in this session.

PendingAsk.description: One question waiting for a human.

expires_in_ms.description: Milliseconds until the call is denied for lack of an answer.

PendingAsks.description: Questions a running session's policy is waiting on.

version.description: `b3:` + 16 hex digits of the component's BLAKE3 hash.

type.description: A stable, relative identifier of the problem kind, e.g. `unauthorized`.

signal.description: Terminating signal, if the process was killed.

call_id.description: Call that started this process (or an ancestor), if known.

ProcessRef.description: Identity of a process, robust against PID reuse.

start_ns.description: Process start time in monotonic nanoseconds; `(pid, start_ns)` is unique.

Relaunching.description: A rewind or fork handed to a detached `wyrd … --relaunch` (202).

relaunch.description: Start the agent again on the new branch (handled by a detached `wyrd`).

dropped.description: Events known to be lost while the sensor was unavailable.

cgroup.description: cgroup of the running Cell, if any.

deny_tools.description: Tools the static pre-execution policy denies (Phase 4; Wasm policies replace it).

head_hash.description: `b3:` + hex of the last event's hash.

policy.description: Wasm policy component (`wyrd run --policy`), reused on relaunch.

cgroup.description: cgroup of the running Cell, if any.

deny_tools.description: Tools the static pre-execution policy denies (Phase 4; Wasm policies replace it).

policy.description: Wasm policy component (`wyrd run --policy`), reused on relaunch.

capabilities.description: Capability name → available, as reported by `wyrd doctor`.

stopped.description: False when no agent was running.

effects.description: Effects attributed to the call or naming it as an ambiguous candidate.

summary.description: Short redacted summary of the result.

turn.description: Transcript turn that issued the call, when known.

note.description: Why; stored in the ledger (keep it free of secrets). At most 2000 characters.

ingestToken.description: Per-session ingest token, derived one-way from the daemon token
